items.information: ¡Cariló Open 2022 será el primer torneo en la Costa desde 2018 y el primero en Cariló! Les recomendamos leer todas las pestañas, especialmente la de ["Pago"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CariloOpen2022#22163-pago-payment). Cariló Open 2022 will be the first competition in the Buenos Aires coast since 2018, and the first one ever held in Cariló! We suggest that you carefully read every tab, especially the ["Payment"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CariloOpen2022#22163-pago-payment) tab.

items.information: ## Welcome to the Malaysia Cube Championship 2022! ![](https://i.imgur.com/oRN01S9m.jpg) For more information, you may visit us at [Malaysia Cube Championship 2022 Website](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/mcc2022) or follow us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/mycubeassociation/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/mycubeassociation/) **Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.** **Please note** Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, There will be **2 types of winner** in this competition: **Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality **Malaysian Category** - Top 3 Malaysian winners of the competition *Participants representing Malaysia will win special medals, prizes and the title of Malaysia Champion.

items.name: New Zealand Nationals 2022

venue.name: Barfoot and Thompson Stadium (https://www.barfootstadium.co.nz/)
venue.details: Main Stadium (Main Stage), Small Gym (Friday Only)

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2022 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.
